hypothalamus.name: Hypothalamus
hypothalamus.description: Region of the brain that integrates the nervous and endocrine systems, synthesizing ADH and neurosecretory releasing factors.

pituitary_gland.name: Pituitary Gland (Hypophysis)
pituitary_gland.description: Small pea-sized master endocrine gland situated at the base of the brain producing TSH, GH, FSH, LH, ACTH, and storing ADH.

thyroid_gland.name: Thyroid Gland
thyroid_gland.description: Butterfly-shaped endocrine gland wrapping around the trachea in the neck, secreting thyroxine to regulate basal metabolic rate.

adrenal_glands.name: Adrenal Glands
adrenal_glands.description: Pyramidal caps atop each kidney; cortex secretes aldosterone (sodium reabsorption) while medulla secretes adrenaline (fight or flight).

pancreas.name: Pancreas (Islets of Langerhans)
pancreas.description: Elongated gland behind stomach; endocrine Islets of Langerhans secrete insulin (beta cells) and glucagon (alpha cells) for blood glucose homeostasis.

ovaries.name: Ovaries (Female Gonads)
ovaries.description: Paired pelvic glands in females producing estrogen (endometrium thickening, puberty) and progesterone (maintains pregnancy).

testes.name: Testes (Male Gonads)
testes.description: Paired gonads inside the external scrotum secreting testosterone, which stimulates spermatogenesis and develops secondary male sexual traits.
